_doc: The shop display's screen (N33, N34), rendered by overlays/screen.mjs to an image sequence that the Blender set maps onto shop.screen_page (nursery.shop_twin). Times are song seconds from the timing map's shots, plus offsets. N33 shows the real public model page (a screenshot recorded by scripts/capture_page.mjs into assets/screens/); N34 cycles through the three auditors' real outputs (log/audits/*_raw.md), each scrolled to its flag or mistake, which a highlighter marks; GLM's hallucination flag holds the longest (brief, N34). The camera holds the screen from N33 to about N34 + 6.1 s, so the panels share that: Gemini and ChatGPT 1.7 s each, GLM the rest, its flag marked by N34 + 4.8 s and held. mark_at / mark_s: when the highlighter starts in the panel and how long it takes (s). Highlight passages are quoted exactly from the raw files.

page._note: Anthropic, Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5 (2026-06-09), captured 2026-10-26 (sidecar .json); scrolled from the title to its first line, "Today we're launching Claude Fable 5: a Mythos-class model that we've made safe for general use." Fact check: docs/fact_check_2026-10-26.md
